allowed_values.description: Possible string values that can be assigned with the tag when the tag is set on an object

propagate.description: Specifies that the tag will be automatically propagated from source objects to target objects

on_conflict.description: Specifies what happens when there is a conflict between the values of propagated tags

created_on.description: Date and time when the tag was created.

database_name.description: Database in which the tag is stored

schema_name.description: Schema in which the tag is stored

owner_role_type.description: The type of role that owns the tag
